mathematical_contract.regularity: H and its lifted-parameter derivative have no common unit-square solution, so every component branch is a graph over the retained parameter and disjoint graphs cannot exchange fiber order
mathematical_contract.turn_assignment: each exact retained fiber is specialized and ordered directly; each algebraic retained fiber refines a lifted isolator until local-field Sturm counting proves exactly one root inside, then a closed count from lifted parameter 0 to the isolator lower endpoint gives the invariant root rank
mathematical_contract.endpoint_multiplicity: the closed local-field count deflates roots at rational interval endpoints and counts each distinct endpoint root once, so rank zero is preserved when a fiber contains lifted parameter 0
mathematical_contract.cell_partition: turning events are inserted only into the graph with the same invariant rank; each graph is then partitioned into oriented monotone overlap cells
mathematical_contract.zero_distance: distance zero has no selected normal sheet, so its exact component predicate is constant true and all source-image coincidences qualify
mathematical_contract.residual_ownership: a residual candidate is suppressed only when both parameters equal the correlated start/start or end/end boundary of an already certified overlap
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact specialization, resultants, root isolation, local-field Sturm counts, replay, and unbounded separating refinement
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, their consumption is reported, and no approximate parameter, cell, orientation, or geometry is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: projection folds, transverse authored-domain entry or exit, singular/shared-derivative components, boundary-coincident components, and unsupported coefficient towers remain explicit uncertainty
